LATCH_ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated emails allowed to edit Latch links. These users can also use the built-in login.

LATCH_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for the built-in login (recommended over Cloudflare Access for personal deployments).

LATCH_AUTH_SECRET.description: Random secret used to sign Latch session cookies, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`.

LATCH_AUTH_EMAIL.description: Optional single email allowed to log in. If omitted, any address in LATCH_ADMIN_EMAILS may log in.

LATCH_AUTH_SESSION_TTL.description: Optional session lifetime in seconds. Defaults to 7776000 (90 days).

POLICY_AUD.description: Cloudflare Access application audience tag from the one-click Access setup modal.

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team URL, for example `https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`.
